Privacy

I use Google Analytics on this website only if you choose to allow it. It helps me understand visits, which pages people read, and clicks on the app download.

Your analytics choice is stored in this browser. You can change it below at any time. Declining removes this site's Google Analytics cookies and stops future collection. It does not erase data already collected.

This website analytics setup does not collect your papers, annotations, or activity inside the Mac app. The hosting providers may separately process request information to serve and protect the site. Downloads are hosted on GitHub.
